stops.title: John's witness beyond the Jordan
stops.text: John says he is not the Christ and points to Jesus as the Lamb of God; the first disciples follow.

stops.title: A wedding at Cana
stops.text: Jesus turns water into wine, and later heals an official's son from a distance.

stops.title: First days in Jerusalem
stops.text: Jesus clears the temple, speaks with Nicodemus by night, and heals at the pool.

stops.title: A woman at Jacob's well
stops.text: Jesus talks with a Samaritan woman, and a town believes.

stops.title: The bread of life
stops.text: Near the Sea of Galilee, Jesus feeds five thousand, walks on the water, and teaches in the synagogue at Capernaum.

stops.title: Lazarus at Bethany
stops.text: Jesus raises Lazarus, and Mary anoints his feet.

stops.title: The last days in Jerusalem
stops.text: Jesus enters the city, washes the disciples' feet, is arrested, crucified, and buried; the tomb is found empty.

stops.title: By the Sea of Tiberias
stops.text: The risen Jesus meets the disciples at the lake, and restores Peter.

real.label: Map of the land from Bethany and Jerusalem in the south to Capernaum in the north, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark where John's story moves.

stops.label: Beyond Jordan
stops.locationNote: Where "Bethany beyond the Jordan" was is debated, so the marker is placed east of the river for illustration.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.locationNote: The same city as stop 3; the marker is offset to show it twice.

real.regionLegend: Regions: darker shading where more sources agree on their extent
